name: green-zone-text-values-with-geometry
note: Author values and the built-in geometry slots in ONE template, which is where index allocation could silently collide. Author values take {0}..{n-1}  and the named geometry slots ({top}/{bottom}) are allocated AFTER them, so `{0}` always means the author's first value no matter how many named slots the output offers. Getting this backwards would not error -- it would quietly print the box's top where a volume belonged, which is the failure mode this pins. Spawn is bar 2: volume 2500 -> `2.5K`, top 13, bottom 10.5.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
plotzone(bar_index == 2, high, low, "Z", extend=extend.bars, bars=1, text="{0:compact} @ {top}-{bottom}", text_value=volume)
